# GeneralCategory

The Unicode general category, one per scalar value.

```rux
pub enum GeneralCategory: int32 {
    Unassigned = 0,
    UppercaseLetter = 1,
    LowercaseLetter = 2,
    TitlecaseLetter = 3,
    ModifierLetter = 4,
    OtherLetter = 5,
    NonspacingMark = 6,
    SpacingMark = 7,
    EnclosingMark = 8,
    DecimalNumber = 9,
    LetterNumber = 10,
    OtherNumber = 11,
    ConnectorPunctuation = 12,
    DashPunctuation = 13,
    OpenPunctuation = 14,
    ClosePunctuation = 15,
    InitialPunctuation = 16,
    FinalPunctuation = 17,
    OtherPunctuation = 18,
    MathSymbol = 19,
    CurrencySymbol = 20,
    ModifierSymbol = 21,
    OtherSymbol = 22,
    SpaceSeparator = 23,
    LineSeparator = 24,
    ParagraphSeparator = 25,
    Control = 26,
    Format = 27,
    Surrogate = 28,
    PrivateUse = 29
}
```

`Copy`.
The ordinals match the generated table and must not be reordered: the table stores them as numbers.

## Cases

| Name                   | Value | Description                                     |
| ---------------------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `Unassigned`           | `0`   | Unassigned, or outside every range.             |
| `UppercaseLetter`      | `1`   | Lu: an uppercase letter.                        |
| `LowercaseLetter`      | `2`   | Ll: a lowercase letter.                         |
| `TitlecaseLetter`      | `3`   | Lt: a titlecase letter.                         |
| `ModifierLetter`       | `4`   | Lm: a modifier letter.                          |
| `OtherLetter`          | `5`   | Lo: a letter without case.                      |
| `NonspacingMark`       | `6`   | Mn: a nonspacing mark.                          |
| `SpacingMark`          | `7`   | Mc: a spacing combining mark.                   |
| `EnclosingMark`        | `8`   | Me: an enclosing mark.                          |
| `DecimalNumber`        | `9`   | Nd: a decimal digit.                            |
| `LetterNumber`         | `10`  | Nl: a letterlike number.                        |
| `OtherNumber`          | `11`  | No: some other number.                          |
| `ConnectorPunctuation` | `12`  | Pc: a connector.                                |
| `DashPunctuation`      | `13`  | Pd: a dash.                                     |
| `OpenPunctuation`      | `14`  | Ps: an opening bracket.                         |
| `ClosePunctuation`     | `15`  | Pe: a closing bracket.                          |
| `InitialPunctuation`   | `16`  | Pi: an initial quote.                           |
| `FinalPunctuation`     | `17`  | Pf: a final quote.                              |
| `OtherPunctuation`     | `18`  | Po: other punctuation.                          |
| `MathSymbol`           | `19`  | Sm: a mathematical symbol.                      |
| `CurrencySymbol`       | `20`  | Sc: a currency symbol.                          |
| `ModifierSymbol`       | `21`  | Sk: a modifier symbol.                          |
| `OtherSymbol`          | `22`  | So: some other symbol.                          |
| `SpaceSeparator`       | `23`  | Zs: a space separator.                          |
| `LineSeparator`        | `24`  | Zl: the line separator.                         |
| `ParagraphSeparator`   | `25`  | Zp: the paragraph separator.                    |
| `Control`              | `26`  | Cc: a control character.                        |
| `Format`               | `27`  | Cf: an invisible formatting character.          |
| `Surrogate`            | `28`  | Cs: a surrogate half, which no scalar value is. |
| `PrivateUse`           | `29`  | Co: private use.                                |
